I replied to Tobias in a thread on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the depot was **Southgate**.

Priyanka's incident post from 3 Sep 2025 says label printing stalled and Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. Her note closing the incident that evening says Southgate cleared the backlog once labels were printing again. Tobias is a member of that channel, so I only used messages he can already see.
